schema.description: Updatable attributes of an offer. Id, IdSegment and the creation/edition attributes are read-only.

ReferenceOffer.description: Shared Key of the Offer between ProAbono and your application (Often used for accounting purposes).

IsVisible.description: Visibility of the offer in the hosted pages.

Order.description: Define the position of the Offer among all Offers when displayed in the hosted Offer Pages.

AmountUpFront.description: Amount of the Upfront fee, Setup fee or Initial fee of your offer in cents.

AmountTrial.description: Amount of the Trial period in cents.

AmountRecurrence.description: Amount of each recurrence in cents.

CountMinRecurrences.description: Minimum recurrences the customer will be committed to pay.

AmountTermination.description: Amount of the Termination Fee in cents.

schema.title: OfferUpdate
